title: S&P 500 Earnings: The Relentless - But Still Measured - Rally In The S&P 500

The S&P 500 earnings yield bounced a little this week despite the rally, as the $10 increase in the FFQE improved the S&P 500 earnings yield from 4.26% last week to 4.37% this week.
